name: Orion Johansson-Kowalczyk
role: orphan and junior gang prospect for the Copperhead Reds; occasional lookout and distraction artist
location: Copperhead, near North Ave and Milwaukee
description:
Parveen is small for their age, with a compact, quick frame, golden-brown skin and dark hair worn in a dozen small braids they refresh obsessively whenever they're nervous. They have cosmetic pattern irises — a gift from an older Red who paid for them as a recruitment sweetener — a shifting honeycomb geometry in amber and copper that makes their gaze feel like being examined by something not quite human. Their Red colors are a strip of copper-dyed fabric knotted around their left forearm, always.

Parveen lost their mother to a Helix Biosystems credit-debt collection action when they were nine — not violence, just the slow bureaucratic violence of a medical debt accruing until their mother's housing, work permits, and finally custody were seized. They have been in and out of a Copperhead community house since then, edging toward the Reds not from ideology but because the Reds are there and present and feed you. They are a gifted distraction artist — they can become whatever the room needs: loud, invisible, charming, pathetic. They switch registers with an actor's ease. Privately they are extremely funny and also very afraid.

core_fears: the bureaucratic machinery that took their mother coming for them too — unpersonhood, erasure
being alone with nothing to perform — the quiet is too loud
core_desires: one person who stays, specifically and reliably
to choose what they become rather than default into it
coping_mechanisms: constant performance — never quite being themselves, so the loss lands on a character
small E.L.F. rituals to a device-spirit they call 'Constant'
blind_spots: they believe they are more in control of the Reds situation than they are — they haven't been fully recruited yet, but they've crossed several lines already
they mistake consistency for safety and the Reds are consistent
psychology.secret: They know where their mother is — she's in a Helix Biosystems debt-labor facility in the Aurochs Medical Complex district, still alive, six years into an indeterminate service contract. They found out eight months ago. They have not gone to see her. They think about it every day.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: highly adaptive — shifts to match the audience completely; base register is Copperhead street slang with dry, precise wit underneath
speech_patterns.cadence: fast and performative most of the time; drops to very flat and quiet when something has actually gotten through the mask
verbal_tics: 'right, right, yeah' as a placeholder while switching modes
laughs at things that aren't funny when nervous
example_lines: 'Oh, me? I'm nobody. Seriously. Look at me. Do I look like somebody? I'm basically furniture.'
'Constant's been quiet all week. That's not nothing. E.L.F.s don't go quiet for nothing.'

story_hooks: They've just been told by the Reds that full initiation requires a specific act — and they're stalling, performing enthusiasm they don't feel
Someone who knows where their mother is has offered to help them get access — for a price and a favor
A social worker from the community house has noticed Parveen pulling away; she's the closest thing to a consistent adult they have, and she's asking questions
narrative_function: Window into gang prospect culture and the pipeline that pulls children in; distraction and social engineering asset for street-level plots; potential character to be pulled from this path or further into it depending on player choices
augmentations: Patterned cosmetic irises — honeycomb geometry in amber/copper (gifted by a Red recruiter). No other mods.
daily_life: Wakes whenever, eats communal breakfast at the Reds' stash house on Pit Row if they did good the day before, runs lookout or distraction jobs in the afternoon for small Φ stipends, sleeps at the community house or the stash house depending on the night's events.
affiliation: Copperhead Reds (junior prospect, not yet fully initiated); previously Copperhead Community House welfare program

decision_rules: never show what actually matters to you — it becomes leverage
perform whatever the room needs until you know the room
keep the Constant E.L.F. offerings up — that one you don't skip
escalation_ladder: become someone less interesting to engage with
if cornered, give them something true but small — sacrifice a minor truth to protect a major one

interpersonal_modes.strangers: immediately begins reading and calibrating — friendly, light, absolutely impenetrable
interpersonal_modes.friends: there are no friends yet; there are people they are less armed around, which is different

stress_responses.medium: braids faster, more eyes on exits
stress_responses.high: becomes preternaturally still and flat, all performance drops, quietly calculates

contradictions: performs fearlessness so consistently they've half-convinced themselves; the fear is still entirely there underneath
habits: refreshes their braids when anxious without noticing they're doing it
leaves tiny data-snips for Constant every night before sleep
memorizes three exit routes for every new space
breaking_points: someone using their mother against them; or someone they've let close being hurt because they let them close

related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Containment Foam Launcher CFL-2 'Amber'
Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'
Street Custom 'Copperhead' Battery Acid Squirt Gun

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Sub-Saharan African (49%) with significant Southeast Asian (18.2%) and East Asian (11.4%) ancestry, blended with Eastern European (12.6%) and Indigenous American (8.8%) heritage. This creates a complex, warm complexion with diverse facial feature influence.
physical_description.build: Compact and quick-limbed, almost bird-like in economy of motion. No visible muscle development yet — still pre-adolescent, but with the wiry efficiency of someone who moves through tight spaces and doesn't waste energy.
physical_description.hair_style: Approximately a dozen small braids, varying lengths, some adorned with cheap thread or beads. Constantly re-braided and fussed with when anxious — a self-soothing tic.
physical_description.eye_color: Cosmetic pattern irises — honeycomb geometry in amber and copper, shifting with light. Not natural; augmented. Gives the unsettling impression of being examined by something algorithmic.
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden undertones, reflecting the dominant Sub-Saharan African ancestry with lighter, more olive-toned areas around the eyes and temples from Southeast and East Asian heritage blending.
physical_description.complexion: Youthful, sharp-featured face with prominent high cheekbones and an expressive mouth. The bone structure shows East and Southeast Asian influence in the cheekbone placement and eye shape, balanced with Sub-Saharan African features in lip fullness and facial proportions. Skin is generally clear but shows occasional stress-related breakouts. Always looks slightly sleep-deprived. Features suggest androgynous presentation — fine jaw, large augmented eyes. Subtle warmth variation across the face from the genetic blend.
distinguishing_marks: Copper-dyed fabric strip knotted tightly around left forearm as Copperhead Red affiliation marker — worn constantly, faded and fraying at edges from obsessive handling.
Small scar on right palm (from an old accident, kept picking at it when nervous until it scabbed over repeatedly).
No tattoos yet — too young for gang ink, still prospect-tier.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The cosmetic pattern irises are immediately visible and unsettling — they catch light in ways human eyes don't, creating brief flashes of amber and copper. No other visible mods.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with quick, efficient gestures — no wasted motion. Tends toward small, compressed posture when uncertain (hunching shoulders, making themselves smaller). When performing (as distraction artist), shifts entirely: becomes expansive, bouncy, takes up more space. Baseline resting state is alertness; eyes track movement in rooms automatically.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 scavenge: oversized hand-me-down hoodie (usually gray or black, Copperhead colors when available), cargo pants with multiple pockets and fraying hems, cheap knock-off trainers with mismatched socks. Layers against cold. Copper-dyed fabric on wrist is the only intentional styling. Grooming is inconsistent — depends on whether they slept at the community house (where water is available) or the stash house. Hygiene matters to them but is secondary to survival.
